title: Cloud Sync Prototype 1
notes: Adds private Firebase email/password sign-in to Drill Log and Shot Diagram menus.
Adds manual upload of the current Drill Log or Shot Diagram while preserving all existing local saving.
Lists only the signed-in user's cloud documents of the currently open document type.
Downloads a selected cloud document only after a replacement warning and confirmation.
Tracks revision number, updated time, signed-in account, source device, MITHRIL version, and populated-hole count.
Allows deleting a cloud copy without deleting the local document.
Does not add automatic synchronization, live collaboration, PDFs, attachments, or company-wide sharing yet.
Preserves m39.8 Drill Log to Shot Diagram import and all m39.7 field-entry, timing, export, backup, and offline workflows.
